intro: X and H identify platform generations, while Hyper, CloudDC, Twin and SuperBlade are families that span generations. The year marks the platform's public introduction; a specific model or later CPU/GPU configuration may arrive afterward. X13 and H13 also contain entry and edge branches with different start dates.

generations.label: H13 · EPYC 9004
generations.summary: Introduced in November 2022 for AMD's EPYC 9004 platform. Later board revisions in selected systems add EPYC 9005 support without renaming the underlying H13 generation.

generations.label: X13 · Xeon Scalable
generations.summary: Unveiled in November 2022, with broad launch in January 2023. Fifth-generation Xeon support followed in December 2023, within X13.

generations.label: H13 · EPYC 8004 edge
generations.summary: The EPYC 8004 WIO and short-depth edge branch arrived in September 2023. Its H13 name does not mean this branch launched with EPYC 9004 in 2022. EPYC 8005 support is a later 2026 refresh of the selected model, not a new 2023 capability.

generations.label: X13 · Xeon E-2400 entry
generations.summary: Supermicro introduced its E-2400 entry-server range in December 2023. This branch has its own timing, separate from the earlier X13 Xeon Scalable portfolio.

generations.label: H13 · EPYC 4004 entry
generations.summary: The EPYC 4004 entry branch was introduced in May 2024. EPYC 4005 configurations followed in May 2025; H13 also labels earlier SP5 and SP6 platforms with different CPU sockets.

generations.label: X14 · Intel Xeon 6
generations.summary: Announced in April 2024 and initially launched with E-core CPUs in June. P-core models and accelerator variants arrived in later waves; X14 is a platform label, not one universal release date.

generations.label: H14 · EPYC 9005 era
generations.summary: Introduced in October 2024. Selected H14 designs also accept EPYC 9004; MI350-series GPU configurations were a later June 2025 addition.

generations.label: H15 · EPYC 9006
generations.summary: Announced in July 2026, bringing the EPYC 9006 generation to Supermicro's portfolio. Individual model availability follows its own schedule.

generations.label: H12 · EPYC 7002 / 7003
generations.summary: H12 debuted with EPYC 7002 in August 2019. Later EPYC 7003 support is model- and BIOS-specific; a generation date is not every system introduction.

intelhyper.note: Named in the July 2024 X14 portfolio. The date describes this model's documented existence; its current CPU and GPU choices include later qualifications.

amd1.note: Explicitly listed in the October 2024 H14 Hyper data sheet. Supporting the older EPYC 9004 CPU does not make this an H13 system.

amd2.note: Explicitly listed in the October 2024 H14 Hyper data sheet. Platform age and the CPU installed in a particular build are separate facts.

amdcloud.note: Uses the H13SSW board. The displayed year dates the H13 EPYC 9004 generation, not a verified first-sale date for this SKU. EPYC 9005 requires a later 2.x motherboard revision.

intelcloud.note: Named in the July 2024 X14 portfolio. P-core support shown today is a later CPU option within the same platform generation.

inteltwin.note: Named in the July 2024 X14 portfolio. GrandTwin is the multi-node family name; X14 identifies this example's platform generation.

amdtwin.note: Uses the H13SST-G board. The displayed year dates the platform generation, not a verified launch date for this exact GrandTwin. Later board revision 2.x enables EPYC 9005.

h15twin.note: The H15 portfolio was announced in July 2026. This EPYC 9006 / SP7 model belongs to that generation; a separate exact-SKU launch date has not been established here.

blade.note: The July 2024 X14 portfolio explicitly lists SBI-622B-1NE34. This dates the compute-blade generation, not the first appearance of SuperBlade enclosures as a family.

tower.note: This X13SCL-F tower belongs to the E-2400 entry-server branch introduced in December 2023. The platform date is shown because an exact SKU introduction date is not established here; Xeon 6300 support is a later qualification.

edge.note: The September 2023 H13 Telco/Edge data sheet explicitly names AS-1115S-FWTRT. Its EPYC 8004 edge branch started later than the H13 EPYC 9004 branch. Its current EPYC 8005 support is a 2026 CPU refresh; original platform age and current CPU qualification are separate.

petascale.note: Named in the July 2024 X14 portfolio. This is the all-flash storage model's documented generation, not the launch year of the wider Petascale family.

capacity.note: An X14 storage platform. The displayed year dates X14's introduction; the exact first announcement or shipment date of this 90-drive SKU is not established here.

pciegpu.note: This X13 PCIe GPU platform supports 4th and 5th Gen Xeon Scalable. X13 was unveiled in 2022 and broadly launched in 2023; the 5th Gen CPU refresh followed in December 2023. Exact SKU debut is not established here.

instinctair.note: Named as coming soon in the October 2024 H14 brochure. MI350-series configurations were announced in June 2025; the earlier model date does not date every supported GPU.

instinctliquid.note: Named in the June 2025 MI350-series announcement and listed as available to order. This dates the documented accelerator configuration, not necessarily the chassis’s first introduction or shipment; H14 itself began in 2024.

hgx.note: X14 began in 2024, but Supermicro's HGX B300 systems entered volume shipments in September 2025. Use 2025 to understand this accelerator era rather than assuming B300 was available at the original X14 launch.

gaudi.note: Supermicro's September 2024 product brief explicitly introduces SYS-822GA-NGR3 with Xeon 6 hosts and Gaudi 3 accelerators. This is a particular X14 AI design.

amdentry.note: The 21 May 2024 EPYC 4004 announcement explicitly links AS-3015A-I under Tower Servers. This establishes the model by May 2024, not an exact first-sale date. The separate 13 May 2025 announcement documents its EPYC 4005 refresh.

amdpcie.note: Uses H14DSG-O-CPU. The 2024 year dates the H14 platform, not this exact SKU or its MI350P qualification; a separate model debut is not established here.

amdhgx.note: Uses H14DSG-OM. The 2024 date belongs to H14; HGX B300 is a later accelerator era, with portfolio volume-shipment evidence in September 2025. This does not prove the exact SKU shipped then.

amdblade.note: H15 was announced in July 2026. The current SBA-817V7-1N page says Coming Soon; the generation date is not a shipping date for this 8U-enclosure blade.

amdlegacy.note: H12 began in 2019. This exact model has no independently established first announcement or sale date in this profile; EPYC 7003 and MI210 are later capabilities.

mi300x.note: The exact MI300X model was named in the 6 December 2023 OEM announcement. H13 started in 2022; current EPYC 9005 support is a later board-revision-dependent option.

h15hyper.note: H15 was announced in July 2026. The exact model is documented on its live OEM product page; its first announcement and shipping dates are not established here.
